verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI (sentry-cli) for debug information files, releases, source maps and code mappings, and also offers an AI-oriented command (`npx @sentry/ai install`) that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to install and configure Sentry. Missing for 10: evidence the CLI is built for agent-driven workflows beyond setup (such as querying or triaging issues from the terminal), detailed docs on the @sentry/ai command, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
